name: XD001
purification: Story only: nine locks, nine ROMs

phase.heading: Phase 6 — XD001
phase.format: XD001 (ss.cipher.xd001) is a Colossus behind nine locks. Each lock is one of the nine methods. Each Data ROM earned in its own region removes its own lock before the fight begins (a late ROM does not). Each lock that remains is a shield bar to be broken, and while it stands it applies its region's condition to the field.

name: M2
purification: Story only: break the four armor seals (Phase 6)

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Roof: Project M2 (Colossus)
phase.format: M2 (ss.rocket.m2, XD002) is a Colossus with four armor seals (two shoulders, chest, crown), each with its own shield bar. It cannot be knocked out while a seal remains. Breaking a seal removes one of its moves, in this order: Mind Vault, Null Pulse, Heart Eclipse, and last its obedience.

name: Dark Celebi
purification: Story only: break the three Thorn Rings and call it by the name Kurt gave you

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Welcome: Dark Celebi (Colossus)
phase.format: Dark Celebi (ss.rocket-return.dark-celebi, XD003) is a Colossus inside three Thorn Rings. Each ring is a shield bar and a rule.

name: Abyssal
purification: Story only: break the Blue Orb's three links

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Awakening: Abyssal and Cinderheart (Colossus)
phase.format: Two Colossi at once: Abyssal (ss.aqua.abyssal, XD004) and Cinderheart (ss.magma.cinderheart, XD005). Neither can be knocked out. Each is held by its Orb through three links, and each link is a shield bar. The player wins when all six links are broken, or when one titan's three are broken and the other's are held shut by allies.

name: Cinderheart
purification: Story only: break the Red Orb's three links

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Awakening: Abyssal and Cinderheart (Colossus)
phase.format: Two Colossi at once: Abyssal (ss.aqua.abyssal, XD004) and Cinderheart (ss.magma.cinderheart, XD005). Neither can be knocked out. Each is held by its Orb through three links, and each link is a shield bar. The player wins when all six links are broken, or when one titan's three are broken and the other's are held shut by allies.

name: Stillhour
purification: Story only: break its two Red Chains

phase.heading: Phase 6 — Zero Hour: Stillhour and Farshore (Colossus)
phase.format: Two Colossi: Stillhour (ss.galactic.stillhour, XD006) and Farshore (ss.galactic.farshore, XD007). Each is held by two Red Chains (three after a Raid 5 Failure). They cannot be knocked out; the chains are the targets.

name: Farshore
purification: Story only: break its two Red Chains

phase.heading: Phase 6 — Zero Hour: Stillhour and Farshore (Colossus)
phase.format: Two Colossi: Stillhour (ss.galactic.stillhour, XD006) and Farshore (ss.galactic.farshore, XD007). Each is held by two Red Chains (three after a Raid 5 Failure). They cannot be knocked out; the chains are the targets.

name: Absolute
purification: Story only: pull the three Splicer wedges

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Crown: Absolute (Colossus)
phase.format: Absolute (ss.plasma.absolute, XD008) is a Colossus held together by three Splicer wedges, each a shield bar. It cannot be knocked out while a wedge holds.

name: The Battery
purification: Story only: close the flower's three petals

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Flower Opens: The Battery (Colossus)
phase.format: The Battery (ss.flare.battery, XD009) is a Colossus. It does not wake and cannot be knocked out. It is fought through the flower's three petals, each a shield bar and a rule. Closing a petal needs its shield broken and one free action at its housing.

name: The Mother Beast
purification: Story only: part the three veils and be heard

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Deep: The Mother Beast (Colossus)
phase.format: The Mother Beast (ss.aether.mother-beast, XD010) is a Colossus wrapped in three veils. It cannot be knocked out. Each veil is a shield bar, and behind each is something she is holding.

name: The Darkest Day
purification: Story only: cut the three feeds, then outlast it

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Darkest Day (Colossus)
phase.format: The Darkest Day (ss.macro-cosmos.darkest-day, XD011) is a Colossus fed by three feeds, each a shield bar. While a feed stands, it cannot be knocked out and the player's Pokémon cannot Dynamax (it is drinking it all).

name: The Cassiopeia Engine
purification: Story only: five Bosses pull five cores

phase.heading: Phase 6 — The Cassiopeia Engine (Colossus)
phase.format: The Cassiopeia Engine (ss.star.cassiopeia-engine, XD012) is a Colossus with five cores, one per Starmobile, each a shield bar (four after a Raid 4 Triumph, six after a Failure). It cannot be knocked out while a core is seated.
